methods.label: Subtract and recognize each power
methods.explanation:
Subtract the known addend in each equation to leave a single power. Since \(3^4=81\) and \(5^3=125\), we obtain
\[
\begin{aligned}
3^p&=90-81=9=3^2,\\
2^r&=76-44=32=2^5,\\
6^s&=1421-125=1296=6^4.
\end{aligned}
\]
For the last equality, \(6\cdot6\cdot6\cdot6=36\cdot36=1296\).

Thus \(p=2\), \(r=5\), and \(s=4\). Their product is
\[
p\cdot r\cdot s=2\cdot5\cdot4=40,
\]
choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
